description: This file is a script for testing extensions within a project, utilizing external tools such as 'pnpm' and 'vitest'. It handles argument parsing, running test batches, and managing process execution.

methods.name: runVitestBatch
methods.description: Executes a batch of 'vitest' tests via a child process, returning a promise that resolves with the exit code.

methods.name: printNoTestsMessage
methods.description: Logs a message indicating no tests were found for the given extension plan.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main async function orchestrating argument parsing, test plan resolution, and test execution.
